question: Should ClawHub enforce the linked PR's proposed 40-character skill display-name policy, including the legacy over-limit republish exception?
rationale: Current main has no maximum title policy, and choosing the exact limit plus grandfathering behavior is product policy rather than a pure bug fix.

options.title: Adopt 40-character limit
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its hosted-publish and GitHub-sync compatibility behavior matches the desired catalog policy.

options.title: Choose a different limit
options.body: Ask the PR author to adjust the constant, validation copy, and tests before merge.

options.title: Leave titles unconstrained
options.body: Close or reject the linked PR and keep existing UI-only truncation without a write-path limit.

recommendation.title: Adopt 40-character limit
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its hosted-publish and GitHub-sync compatibility behavior matches the desired catalog policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Blame on the current publish and sync validation paths points to Patrick Erichsen's v0.23.1 snapshot, making him the best available owner for the policy decision.
